authorization: User: settle the parameters and review cover identified as silty clay; material design only

cover.geological_role: User confirmed Chinese engineering lithology: 粉质黏土
cover.electrical_role: Retained low-loss weak-dispersion research hypothesis; not a verified representative silty-clay spectrum
cover.provenance: User designed and adopted 2026-10-05 cover recipe; kept identical to executed fine2m baseline

rock.provenance: User's center/span choice; tau inherited as an explicit design convention, not derived from sandstone measurements
rock.tau_rationale: Keep prior proposed pole time and locate polarization-loss peak near low band edge; two real-part constraints do not determine tau uniquely

stadler2024_moist_silty_clay.reading_scope: Online relevant methods: test-site silty-clay description, subsurface characterization, Eq1 and Table1; no full-paper reproduction
stadler2024_moist_silty_clay.sample: Danube southern Germany loess; smectite/quartz; 19vol% water; CEC14-15meq/100g; not our site
stadler2024_moist_silty_clay.role: Measured-spectrum fitted high-loss example; retained for analytic comparison, not the main cover recipe or an executable solver input

controlled_comparison.new_independent_variable: Bedrock constitutive dispersion (epsilon_infinity and delta chosen jointly with fixed sigma and tau)
controlled_comparison.note: Both target/background sides of a future matched pair must cite the same material design; previously executed inputs and outputs remain historical

limitations: Chinese engineering 粉质黏土 classification is not a one-to-one USDA silt-loam or silty-clay texture identification
Lithology name alone does not determine complex permittivity, moisture, bulk conductivity or relaxation strength
Constant sigma_DC does not make losses unchanged when Debye dispersion is added
No claim that adding bedrock dispersion improves Bscan or identifies the sim-to-field discrepancy
A separate complete execution contract and appropriate numerical/resource verification are required before a solver run
